lines.t: He was born with an ache in his chest
Hollow eyes chasing bodies in a sense
Every touch felt warm for a while
Then it bled through his fingers like bile
He kept feeding the void with the noise in his head
Burned out nights and a half made bed
Every eye of love he burned in to smoke
Another promise that he never could hold
He kept reaching, always reaching
But the ceiling never cracked
Every heartbeat only answered
With an echo calling back
All this longing, all this hunger
Every tear and every scar
Was a map etched in his marrow
Pointing past his shattered heart
There's a name inside the silence
There's a fire behind the pain
Calling through the fallen ruins
And saying you were made for more than shame
You were made for more than shame
He tried kindness as a kind of cure
Giving love just to feel more sure
Loving hard but it came out twisted
Needing praise for every breath he gifted
He was bleeding out rays just to fill his own veins
Throwing bandages on everyone's pain
But every time the world ran dry
He cursed the sky and never knew why
He kept giving, always giving
Till he crumbled under weight
Cause a broken cup can't pour forever
When it's cracked by fear and hate
All this longing, all this hunger
Every failure, every fall
Was a neon cross in darkness
Writing truth along the wall
There's a love that doesn't bargain
Doesn't need to be repaid
Bleeding mercy through the ages
For the lost and unafraid
Then the ground gave way beneath him
All his idols turned to dust
Every crutch snapped in the silence
Every promise turned to rust
He fell face first in the wreckage
With nothing left to prove
And the only thing still burning
Was a voice that wouldn't move
Let the ruins be your altar
Let the dead man finally die
There's a love that doesn't need you
Just to justify its why
You were wired for this fire
From your first unwanted cry
And the hands that hold the cosmos
Let themselves be crucified
Now the longing's been dismantled
Every chain has come undone
All the hunger found its ending
In the wounded, risen one
He's a monument of mercy, living proof of holy scars
Where the endless love of heaven pours like rivers through his heart
Now he walks into a room like a quiet storm
Not to take but to keep hearts warm
No more flinching when the thunder hits
No more begging for the counterfeit
He's a broken stone turned fountainhead
Breathe in peace where the hopeless bled
Every scar upon his soul is a window now
Where the wild burning love pours out
He's not reaching just to fill him
He's not loving just to stay
He's a vessel of a kingdom
That will never fade away
All this longing, all this hunger
Every wound and every fight
Was a compass through the darkness
Pointing straight into the light
Now that perfect love inside him
Drives out fear in every soul
This is purpose, this is meaning
This is life made fully whole
From the cradle of his aching
To the graveyard of his pride
Every breath was always leading to the Father satisfied
Now the greatest word is lost still
But it's nothing like before
It's an ocean breaking through him
And he's starving nevermore
Thanks for watching!
